_about: The usual plan for each kind of inquiry (31-ONE-COMMAND.md §3.3), read by the front door (orchestration/front_door.py). Recipes are data and name no subject. Each step is planned only when its 'when' condition holds for the focus, as read from the graph and the inquiry file; the conditions are the front door's own names (front_door.CONDITIONS). 'after' names the actions a step waits for (per source, a reading waits only for its own source's finder). Reading runs with --unread, so a first run and a retry are the same command and a retry resumes where it stopped (D-175). Arguments use {qid}, {focus}, {inquiry}, {workId}, {lens}. A 'manual' step is done by the curator: the orchestrator asks, and records the answer (D-177). A step whose worker is not built is listed as an open question, never as a plan item. Costs are estimates for planning, not billing caps: the spend meter's budget is the cap (curation/budgets.json).

estimates._note: Planning estimates in USD, set from the spend ledger (a lens reading measured $0.027 a passage on Sonnet, 2026-11-24: $3.22 for 121 passages of the first orchestrated reading); perReadingStartUSD is the cache write a reading pays once at its start (about $0.29 measured, the lens packet); the curator may change them.

steps.rationale: the focus is not in the graph yet: its Wikidata record makes it a proposed Entity with its first claims
outputs: a proposed Entity for the focus

steps.instructions: Read the rights for {source} at its own site ({homepage}). Quote them in curation/sources.json under {systemId}, with the page and the date; set its rights class and nonCommercial; register it if they allow. Answer with the class, or with 'not usable' and why.
steps.rationale: check a source's rights at the source and register it (free, by hand: rights are read, never assumed)
outputs: the source's rights quoted in the registry
its status: registered, or left a candidate with the reason

steps.rationale: no Wikipedia article is held for the focus: its revision orients the inquiry and gives the article's references
the inquiry reads fewer works than the recipe's minimum: the agent chooses witnesses from the registry's catalogues
the chosen copies are preserved under the registry's rights rule and added to the inquiry, with their briefs
the passages of this source that concern the focus have not been selected by the finder
the general reader has not read every assigned passage of this source
outputs: proposed claims, attributed to the source

steps.rationale: the lens specialist has not read this source's assigned passages (39)
lens questions are open, thin or unmarked: a fresh analysis marks them against what has been read since
outputs: a lens analysis with marks and named gaps

steps.rationale: the event has no phase spine yet
how each new claim relates to the stored ones (31 §3.5)
an independent critic reads the stored proposals (31 §3.6)
Chrystallum's account of the focus (29 §4): the contract is built (narrative/account.py), the outline agent that writes it is not
outputs: Chrystallum's account, traced statement by statement

stoppingRules: a batch of reading adds no new independent evidence (31 §3.8)
